blocks.text: We will make reasonable efforts to:

items: Acknowledge a valid channel report within [TARGET BUSINESS DAYS]
Review whether the report affects an in-scope
Request clarification where needed
Provide periodic updates when practical
Coordinate remediation and any agreed disclosure

blocks.text: If you make a good-faith effort to comply with this policy, stay within the listed scope and avoid harm
Do not publicly disclose a suspected or confirmed issue
We do not currently operate a monetary bug-bounty program
We use reporter contact and report information to investigate, communicate, protect systems, maintain records
We may update, suspend or withdraw this policy
